hardware_findings.R-CAST-BF16FP16: dav_c220 VCast has NO bf16->fp16 overload (CastIntrinsicsImpl no-match, probe_casts.py); workaround used: host precast of KV + 3-step P emulation fp32->bf16->fp32->fp16 (probe_casts2.py P2b bit-exact)
hardware_findings.R-FP32FP16-ROUNDING: direct fp32->fp16 VCast differs from torch round-nearest-even (probe P2a FAIL) — must not be used where bit-exactness matters
hardware_findings.R-FP16-NOBW: fp16 transfers are NOT faster than bf16 at equal byte count (both 2B/elem): a1a same-byte regime measured C mte2 39.5ms vs 31.0ms (+27%), V mte3 +28%, V mte2 +16% — fp16 paths are structurally SLOWER on dav_c220
hardware_findings.AUDIT_ERR_A1A: evidence-audit s4.1 A1a row claims ws_kv fp16 halves its GM traffic (4.83->2.42GB x3 items = -7.28GB): ARITHMETIC ERROR — fp16 and bf16 are both 2 bytes; the audit itself notes ws_p traffic is unchanged under fp16. The -7.24/-7.28GB saving is phantom; C1/C2 combination projections (23.42GB, 26-34ms) inherit the error
